senses.gloss: (אֶגְדִּיקָס, popular corrupt. אנד׳, cmp. אַנְדִּיסְקֵי) m. (ecdicus = cognitor sive defensor civitatis, esp. in Asia Minor) state’s agent, syndic.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:10">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>א׳ ממונה על ביא שלה</he> (ed. <he>אנד׳</he>; <he>בית שלו</he>, corr. acc.) when an ecdicus is in the country, he holds the authority over the public road (curator viæ, v. <cite ref="B00537"><he>בִּיָּא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 794:1">Yalk. Ps. 794</cite> (a. Ar.) <he>אגר׳</he>, corr. acc.—Pl. <he>אֶגְדִּיקִין</he>, <he>אנ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> (ed. <he>אנ׳</he>).
